newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Acesita upgraded to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Acesita upgraded to hold.

text.p: -- ING Barings said in a report it upgraded Brazilian stainless steel maker Acesita to hold from sell.
-- Analyst Mirela Rappaport forecast gross margins to improve considerably while interest expenses will continue to produce negative operating cash flows.
-- Also, the inauguration of a new stainless steel line next year should further boost margins and allow for positive operating cash flows in 1998.

-- The report said Acesita is currently trading at 20x and 10x EV/EBITDA in 1997 and 1998, respectively. The company is trading at a significant premium compared to its peers in the sector and further downside potential in the stock is not expected, it added.
-- Acesita preferred shares were traded at 2.66 reais, down 0.75 percent.
